title: Financial Shocks and Firm Innovation in Supply Chain Networks
authors: Emanuele Brancati; Raoul Minetti; Susan Chun Zhu
eligible_reason: Not a binary staggered DiD. Firm-level panel of Italian MET survey waves (2009-2017). The regressions interact supply-chain participation (STABLE_SC / SC_NTW2) with continuous bank exposures to the financial and sovereign crises (expo_fin_L2CDS, expo_sov_L2CDS, lagged CDS-weighted exposure of lending banks), with many time-varying firm controls (ln_age, S_grad_employees, L.sales_growth, L.Scarce_mkt_demand_inv, ln_sales_ADJ, fixed_TA_ADJ, ln_VA_L_ADJ) and province/sector dummies; most columns are IV (xtivreg2 / ivregress, instrumenting credit constraints Short_collateral and their supply-chain interaction with the exposures and Fibra x EFIGE online-purchasing shares). Continuous treatment, IV and controls in every column; no data shipped.
design_notes: Stata; DO_FILES_TABLES/TABLE 1.do ... TABLE 6.do, TABLE A2-A8.do. Outcomes Inn_all (innovation), product/process innovation (radical/imitative), R&D. Mostly 2SLS (40 ivregress, 32 xi: xtivreg2 lines), plus xtreg fe and pooled reg with sector-by-year dummies. Cluster PROVDEF.

ineligible_specs_listed.reason: continuous bank-exposure treatment interacted with supply-chain indicator; IV for credit constraints; time-varying firm controls in every column
